title: Iran launches first direct attack on Israel with drones and missiles
body:
On the evening of 13 April 2024, at around 20:00 GMT, Iran launched drones and missiles at Israel in what it called Operation True Promise, the first direct Iranian strike on Israeli territory from Iranian soil. According to US officials, the attack lasted about five hours into the early hours of 14 April. Iran said it was retaliation for the strike on its consular building in Damascus on 1 April, which killed 13 people according to Al Jazeera, including Major General Mohammad Reza Zahedi.

Israeli military spokesman Daniel Hagari said the attack included more than 120 ballistic missiles, 170 drones and more than 30 cruise missiles. The Israeli military said most projectiles were downed outside Israel's borders with help from the United States, United Kingdom and France, and that Jordan intercepted some over its own airspace. US Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin said US forces intercepted dozens of missiles and drones launched from Iraq, Syria and Yemen. Israel reported a small number of hits and minor infrastructure damage at a base in southern Israel. A seven-year-old girl was severely injured by missile fragments, and no deaths were reported.

Iran's mission to the United Nations said the matter could be considered "concluded," but warned that a further Israeli "mistake" would bring a more severe response. The US said it would not join offensive operations against Iran. The UN Security Council called for restraint and the G7 condemned the attack. Israel's retaliatory strike near Isfahan followed on 19 April 2024.
